newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Iberia in talks with five airlines.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Iberia in talks with five airlines.

text.p: Spanish state-owned airline Iberia has held talks among five European airlines on forming a strategic alliance, chairman Xavier de Irala said on Monday.
In a interview published today by the Spanish financial daily Cinco Dias he said "we started talks with British Airways, Air France, KLM, Swissair and Alitalia ".
He said a week ago that Iberia was in the final stages of talks on forming a strategic alliance with an international company.
"We think this alliance has to be a commercial one initially. But then it has to end with an integration process," de Irala said in today's interview.
He added Iberia was also looking for another alliance in America but said this would only be commercial.
De Irala added Iberia has to take important strategic decisions concering its fleet.
State-holding company SEPI has said Iberia would secure an international alliance before the summer with two partners, one American and one European.
